name: SpinLab AI
headline: Lab-grade quarterback biomechanics from a single phone video
overview: SpinLab AI is a quarterback training platform built end to end by Techlio. It turns a phone video into biomechanics data with no sensors or special equipment, and serves players, coaches and programs across the NFL, CFL and major college football.

challenges.title: No accessible biomechanics tools
challenges.text: Professional motion analysis needed lab equipment most players and college programs could not reach.

challenges.title: Manual coaching feedback
challenges.text: Coaches relied on observation, with no quantitative data to track progress or prescribe drills.

challenges.title: No recruiting infrastructure
challenges.text: Players lacked standardized, data-backed reports to share with recruiters.

challenges.title: Fragmented training resources
challenges.text: Drills, coaching calls, video feedback and performance data sat in disconnected tools.

solutions.title: AI biomechanics engine
solutions.text: A computer vision pipeline that converts phone video into 3D analysis covering more than 20 metrics, including release time and hip rotation speed.

solutions.title: Personalized drill engine
solutions.text: Recommendations based on each athlete's biomechanics data, injury risk indicators and performance gaps.

solutions.title: Recruiting and performance dashboard
solutions.text: A data profile with overlay video, leaderboard rankings and shareable reports for coaches and scouts.

solutions.title: Full SaaS platform
solutions.text: Multi-plan subscriptions, coach and player portals, global leaderboards and live coaching call scheduling.

results: Adopted by quarterbacks from the NFL, CFL and 30+ college programs
20+ biomechanical metrics tracked per throw with no hardware
200+ drill library integrated with AI recommendations
Multi-tier subscription model live with coach and player plans
